title: Mummy with Cosmic Orb
description: A bandaged mummy-like figure with glowing red and blue eyes stands in the right foreground, holding a glowing purple orb with an eye symbol. Behind it is a surreal floating cyberpunk city on a dark rocky platform, featuring neon-lit towers, satellite dishes, and colorful geometric shapes floating in a purple and blue cosmic sky with stars and a distant red planet.
